description: Creates a temporary Calendly one-off event type for a host, with a duration and date setting for the meeting availability.

inputSchema.description: Request model for creating a one-off event type.

anyOf.description: Date range setting for events available within a specific date range.

end_date.description: End date for event availability in YYYY-MM-DD format
end_date.title: End Date

start_date.description: Start date for event availability in YYYY-MM-DD format
start_date.title: Start Date

type.description: Must be 'date_range' for this setting type
type.title: Type

anyOf.title: DateRangeSetting

anyOf.description: Date setting for events bookable within a specified number of days from today.

days.description: Number of days in the future that the event can be booked. Must be a positive integer.
days.title: Days

only_weekdays.description: Excludes weekends and only counts Monday - Friday. Required for days_in_future date_setting type.
only_weekdays.title: Only Weekdays

type.description: Must be 'days_in_future' for this setting type
type.title: Type

anyOf.title: DaysInFutureSetting

anyOf.description: Date setting for events with specific available time slots.

spots.description: List of specific available time slots. Each spot must contain 'start_time' and 'end_time' fields (not 'date' and 'time'). Both fields should be ISO 8601 datetime strings.
spots.title: Spots

type.description: Must be 'spots' for this setting type
type.title: Type

anyOf.title: SpotsSetting

date_setting.description:
Date & time availability for this one-off event. Must be an object with a `type` key equal to ONE of: `'date_range'`, `'days_in_future'`, or `'spots'`.
• `date_range` → include `start_date` & `end_date` (YYYY-MM-DD).
• `days_in_future` → include `days` (int) and `only_weekdays` (bool).
• `spots` → include `spots` – list of objects with `start_time` and `end_time` (ISO 8601 datetime strings).
Do NOT use values like `'available_moving'` – that pertains to Shares, not one-off events.
date_setting.title: Date Setting

duration.description: Duration of the event in minutes. Note: Pass this as 'duration', not 'duration_minutes'.
duration.title: Duration

host.description: The URI of the user who will be the host of the one-off event (e.g., 'https://api.calendly.com/users/xxx')
host.title: Host

connected.description: Whether the location service is connected to the host's account. Required for conference-type locations like Zoom, Google Meet, etc.
connected.title: Connected

kind.description: Type of location for the event. Determines how the meeting will be conducted.
kind.title: Kind

location.description: Location string required when kind is 'custom'. Must be a non-empty string.
location.title: Location

name.description: Name of the one-off event type
name.title: Name

timezone.description: IANA timezone identifier for the event scheduling. Determines how times are interpreted and displayed to invitees.
timezone.title: Timezone
